# Adder (CV 5)

*A short, thick-bodied snake patterned like leaf litter, with a triangular head and retractable venomous fangs. It prefers warm cover and an escape route to confrontation.*

**HP:** 5 · **Speed:** Ground 5; swim 4 · **Footprint:** 1x1

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** 1 Boon. · **Stability:** 0.

**DR / resistance:** None · **Condition immunities:** None

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.


**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Communication:** None

**Attributes:** Brawn -2; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge -2; Reason +0

**Eligibility:** Animal 1

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

**Carrying:** up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

## Attacks — Main Action

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Needle bite | Agility | None | 1 physical damage. | 1 physical damage. Poisoned 1. | 2 physical damage. Poisoned 2. |


**Needle bite:** One adjacent creature.

**Defend — Maneuver:** gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** None to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 1, Standard 2, Strong 4 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.

[DA creature card](../creatures/adder.md) · [Summon rules](../../rules/summoning.md)

# Air Elemental (CV 21)

*Dust, leaves and scraps of cloud circle an empty center that turns toward every change in pressure.*

**Attributes:** Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

**HP:** 22 · **Speed:** 6; fly 9 · **Footprint:** 1x1

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** 1 Boon. · **Stability:** 0.

**DR / resistance:** None · **Condition immunities:** Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Communication:** Common

**Eligibility:** Elemental 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use the controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or if the controller is unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot. No summon chains.

**Carrying:** At most 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No crafting training.

## Attacks — Main Action

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hammering gust | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. Push 1. | 7 physical damage. Push 3. |

**Hammering gust:** One visible creature within 5 squares. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

## Maneuvers

**Wind Step:** Move up to 3 squares using a printed movement mode, paying terrain costs. Provokes normally and cannot pass through solid objects or occupied squares.

**Defend:** Gain 1 Boon to defenses until the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** Brawn 1 Boon; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.

# Barrow Guard (CV 23)

*A small elemental made of glowing coals and flickering flame, with bright cracks for eyes. Warmth draws it; uncontrolled curiosity makes it dangerous around dry fuel.*

**HP:** 8 · **Speed:** Ground 6 · **Footprint:** 1x1

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** 1 Boon. · **Stability:** 0.

**DR / resistance:** fire 3 · **Condition immunities:** Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

**Weakness:** Cold damage gives it 1 Bane on its next attack before its next turn (1 Boon to that player defense). Does not stack with itself.

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body. Cannot swallow potions.


**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Communication:** None

**Attributes:** Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

**Eligibility:** Elemental 1

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

**Carrying:** up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

## Attacks — Main Action

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coal touch | Agility | None | 1 fire damage. | 2 fire damage. Burning 1. | 3 fire damage. Burning 2. |


**Coal touch:** One adjacent creature.

**Defend — Maneuver:** gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** None to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 1, Standard 2, Strong 4 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.

# Flesh Golem (CV 29)

*A body assembled from mismatched remains moves with the caution of someone learning where its hands end.*

**Attributes:** Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility -1; Guile -2; Knowledge -2; Reason +0

**HP:** 30 · **Speed:** 5 · **Footprint:** 2x2

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** None. · **Stability:** 1.

**DR / resistance:** Physical 1 · **Condition immunities:** Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Communication:** None

**Eligibility:** Construct 7

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use the controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or if the controller is unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot. No summon chains.

**Carrying:** At most 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No crafting training.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stitched fist | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. Dazed 1. | 9 physical damage. Dazed 2. |

**Basic Melee — Main:** Brawn 1 Boon; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.

**Basic Melee — Main:** Brawn 1 Boon; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.

**HP:** 24 · **Speed:** 5; swim 5 · **Footprint:** 2x2

**Summoned form — player reference.**

# Giant Octopus (CV 22)

*A shifting pattern of copper and cream runs across eight thick arms, each exploring the water independently.*

**Attributes:** Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

**HP:** 26 · **Speed:** 2; swim 7 · **Footprint:** 2x2

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** None. · **Stability:** 1.

**DR / resistance:** None · **Condition immunities:** None

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Communication:** None

**Eligibility:** Animal 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use the controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or if the controller is unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot. No summon chains.

**Carrying:** At most 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No crafting training.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

## Attacks — Main Action

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Binding arms | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. Grappled 1. | 7 physical damage. Grappled 2. |

**Binding arms:** One adjacent creature. The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

## Maneuvers

**Ink Cloud:** While submerged, place heavy cover in up to 3 connected water squares within 2 squares until its next turn. Fully concealed targets cannot be individually targeted. No damage or movement obstruction. Once per scene.

**Defend:** Gain 1 Boon to defenses until the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** Brawn 1 Boon; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.

**Driving strike:** One adjacent creature. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

## Maneuvers

**Rattle of the Grave:** One creature within 2 squares that can hear it gains Frightened 1 of this creature. Once per turn; no damage.

**Defend:** Gain 1 Boon to defenses until the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** Brawn 1 Boon; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.

*A large black corvid with an iridescent throat, wedge-shaped tail and keen, curious eyes. It remembers faces and treats unattended food and interesting objects as opportunities.*

**HP:** 4 · **Speed:** Ground 2; fly 9 · **Footprint:** 1x1

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** 1 Boon. · **Stability:** 0.

**DR / resistance:** None · **Condition immunities:** None

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.


**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Communication:** Calls; cannot report human speech verbatim

**Attributes:** Brawn -2; Fortitude -1; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

**Eligibility:** Animal 1

No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

**Carrying:** up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

**Basic Melee — Main:** 1 Bane to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 1, Standard 1, Strong 2 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.

# Wolf (CV 8)

*A rangy predator with dense gray fur, a narrow muzzle and long legs built for patient pursuit. Wolves live and hunt as a pack, protecting the den before risking a disabling fight.*

**HP:** 10 · **Speed:** Ground 8 · **Footprint:** 1x1

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** 1 Boon. · **Stability:** 0.

**DR / resistance:** None · **Condition immunities:** None

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.


**Senses:** Keen scent within 6 squares.

**Communication:** None

**Attributes:** Brawn +1; Fortitude +1; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

**Eligibility:** Animal 1

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

**Carrying:** up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

## Attacks — Main Action

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Snapping jaws | Brawn | None | 2 physical damage. | 3 physical damage. | 4 physical damage. |
| Pinning bite | Brawn | None | 1 physical damage. | 2 physical damage; Grappled 1. | 3 physical damage; Grappled 1. |


**Snapping jaws:** One adjacent creature.

**Pinning bite:** One adjacent creature. The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

### Circle the Prey — Maneuver

If another conscious, non-Paralyzed ally (not an uncommanded summon) is adjacent to an adjacent enemy, move up to 2 squares without provoking from that enemy. End adjacent to it. Other opportunity attacks and terrain costs apply.

## Passives

**Pack Hunter:** When attacking a target adjacent to another active ally, impose 1 additional Bane on that target’s defense (or gain 1 attack Boon when controlled). Unconscious, Paralyzed and uncommanded summoned allies do not qualify.


**Defend — Maneuver:** gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** None to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.
